_source: Verbatim Thai keys from pototype/accounting-extra2.jsx GLProjectPL (L343-494). Kept in .json (the i18n-guard hook skips .json) so Thai/baht never appear in .tsx/.ts source — same pattern as gl/coa-strings.json + ap/ap-deposit-strings.json. Each value is the prototype phrase VERBATIM (glyph-checked: middot U+00B7, em-dash U+2014, ampersand ASCII). None of these keys exist in i18n-full.json yet -> they render honest Thai (lang=th, tp() returns the key itself) / key-fallback (en/zh/ar) and are handed off for the Wave i18n round (see agents/orch-b-recon/gl-projectpl-i18n.apply.json, override wei-approved:B-249). Reused DICT keys (t(), NOT this file): fin.breadcrumbFinance (breadcrumb 'บัญชี-การเงิน'), common.export (Export btn), common.close (modal 'ปิด'), pm.unitMillion (KPI unit 'ล้านบาท'). Pure-ASCII prototype strings are inline .tsx literals (no Thai): 'GL' crumb, 'GP Margin' / 'Net Margin' headers+labels, 'P&L ·' modal-title prefix, 'PDF' btn.
